Kevin H.: Quick heads-up — planning the multi-region rollout for next Thu. Need signoff on cutoffs, canary coverage and fallback windows. Proposed windows: US 03:00-05:00 UTC, EU 07:00-09:00 UTC, APAC 23:00-01:00 UTC. Any hard blocks?
Maddie R.: Can we freeze branch for version bump 1.8.2 at 02:00 UTC that day? I want a clean CI run before canaries.
Kevin H.: yes, plan is branch-freeze @ 02:00 UTC. Will post the exact git tag procedure in a sec.
Ravi S.: DB migration note — the schema change is non-blocking but requires a read-only fallback for 15m. Can we reserve an extra 10m in each window for the migration handoff?
Carla V.: infra + warm pool: we'll spin warm instances in US+EU 40m ahead, APAC 60m ahead. Need confirmation on instance types (g5x -> ok?)
Sylvia L.: Support coverage: Oncall team can cover US/EU windows, but APAC night will be L2 only unless we bring in a volunteer -> @Maddie R. can you cover escalation? :pray:
Maddie R.: I can be on rotation for the APAC handoff until 00:30 UTC. After that hand off to oncall 2.
deploy-bot: CI status for branch "release/1.8.x": all checks passing (12/12). Canary pipeline scheduled when tag v1.8.2 created. https://ci.internal/redwood/pipelines/12345
Kevin H.: Canary targets: start with 2% traffic for 30m, if telemetry OK bump to 20% for next 30m, then 100% staged roll. Objections?
Ravi S.: Request: add a health-check gate on DB ops for the first canary bump. If any DB error rate >0.5% revert to previous canary snapshot.
Carla V.: We can add that health gate in the rollout orchestration. I'll add metric thresholds: 5xx rate, p50 latency, and db_error_rate.
Kevin H.: Changelog & release notes — Maddie, can you coordinate a short summary for PMs? Add migration instructions and fallback steps.
Maddie R.: On it. I'll drop a PR with release notes + migration instructions by EOD Mon. Ping me for review (PR #412).
Sylvia L.: Legal/compliance check: is there any customer data exposure risk during warmups? Security says no but please double-check E2E tests that hit prod buckets.
Carla V.: confirmed — warm pool uses isolated staging buckets; nothing hits prod data. I'll also run an extra smoke test against a scrubbed dataset.
Kevin H.: Final ask: please react with :thumbsup: if you approve the windows and plan, or :x: if you need changes. I'll lock cutoffs tomorrow once we hit consensus.
Maddie R.: :thumbsup:
Ravi S.: :thumbsup:
Carla V.: :thumbsup:
Sylvia L.: :thumbsup:
Kevin H.: Great — locking branch-freeze @ 02:00 UTC and tag + canary orchestration. Will post final checklist and the rollback playbook in this thread tomorrow. Thanks all.
